title: Hung Shih Tsoo

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
E. O. REG
No. 210
Date 29/3/16

Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPT.
Captain Superintendent's Office

Shanghai, March 29th. 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that Hung Shih Tsoo 洪述祖 arrived from Nanking the day before yesterday and is staying in No.18 Elgin Road.
It is reported that the rebels in Shanghai have sent a man named Zee Yao Ching 徐耀青 to Soochow and Zangchow to induce the military governors of these cities to declare independence. It is said that Zee is prepared to spend $60,000 on the object in view.
It is reported that Arsenal detectives are constantly watching in the western part of Frenchtown.
General Yang received seven code telegrams from Chiangchun Feng on 28th instant, all of which he deciphered himself.
It is said that the rebels here have received a telegram from Huang Hsin 黃興 saying that Tsang Chi 張繼 ex-member of the State Council is coming to Shanghai from Japan.
Four robbers two of whom had been handed over by the Mixed Court, were shot at the Arsenal yesterday afternoon.
It is reported that General Lu, Deputy Military Governor, has sent a telegram to Peking in which he states that a rebel outbreak is sure to take place in Shanghai in the near future.
The Chapel Police arrested three robbers in Wong Ka Zah 丁家宅 village to the north of the S.N.R. Station last night. The outlaws had three revolvers in their possession.

Your Obedient Servant,
McLusky
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
E. O. 登记
编号 210
日期 1916年3月29日

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查处
警司办公室

上海，1916年3月29日。

先生：

据报，洪述祖于前日自南京抵达，现寓居爱而近路（Elgin Road）18号。

据报，上海叛党已派遣一名名为徐耀青的人前往苏州和常州，游说这两座城市的都督宣布独立。据悉，徐为此目的准备花费六万元。

据报，兵工厂侦探正在法租界西部持续监视。

杨将军于本月28日收到来自张勋的七封密码电报，均由其亲自译解。

据悉，本地叛党收到黄兴发来的电报，称前国务会议成员张继将从日本前来上海。

昨日下午，四名强盗在兵工厂被枪决，其中两人此前已由会审公廨移交。

据报，副都督卢将军已向北京发送电报，称上海近期必将发生叛乱暴动。

昨晚，教堂巡捕在北站以北的丁家宅村逮捕了三名强盗。这些匪徒持有三支左轮手枪。

您顺从的仆人，
麦克拉斯基
首席探长

致警察警司
